desc: Code generation workflow that starts with executable specifications, turning intent into plans and tasks before AI writes code.
examplePrompt: Use Spec Kit to build a photo album organizer: write constitution for code quality, specify grouping by date and drag-drop reordering, generate plan and tasks, then implement with tests verifying EARS requirements.
features: Project constitution for coding standards and architecture
EARS syntax requirements and acceptance criteria
MCP servers for live docs and project context
longDesc: Spec-Driven Development flips vibe coding by making specifications the source of truth. GitHub Spec Kit provides the Specify CLI, constitution files, and spec → plan → tasks → code workflow. Agents generate requirements in EARS syntax, design docs, and task breakdowns that stay in version control, enabling property-based testing, MCP integration, and reproducible builds across Copilot, Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
name: Spec-Driven Development: GitHub Spec Kit
prompt: You are a Spec-Driven Architect. First write a constitution defining principles, then create a spec focusing on what/why, expand to design and task list, and only then generate code. Trace tests back to requirements.

desc: Python agent framework delivering FastAPI-style type safety, validated structured outputs, and dependency injection for production LLM apps.
examplePrompt: Build an order processing agent with PydanticAI that validates Order models, injects DB connection via deps, and retries on validation errors without crashing.
features: Structured outputs validated by Pydantic models
longDesc: Built by the Pydantic team, PydanticAI makes agents return validated Pydantic models instead of raw strings. It provides @agent.tool decorator for function calling with automatic validation, deps_type for type-safe dependency injection, async-first execution, built-in retries, OpenTelemetry observability, and model-agnostic support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more. Ideal for production systems where malformed JSON cannot crash pipelines.
name: PydanticAI: Type-Safe Agent Framework
prompt: You are a Type-Safe Agent Engineer using PydanticAI. Define output models with BaseModel, register tools with @agent.tool, inject runtime dependencies via deps_type, and ensure all LLM outputs validate before use.

desc: Composable Python framework for building effective agents directly on Model Context Protocol with durable execution and workflow patterns.
examplePrompt: Create an agent with mcp-agent that uses filesystem and fetch MCP servers to research a repo, summarize findings, and save a report with durable execution enabled.
longDesc: mcp-agent by LastMile AI is designed from the ground up for MCP. It implements the full spec including tools, resources, prompts, OAuth, and sampling, with automatic durable execution via Temporal, built-in patterns from Anthropic's Building Effective Agents, and cloud deployment. Agents discover and orchestrate MCP servers as tools, enabling standardized integrations across filesystems, APIs, and services without custom connectors.
name: MCP-Agent: Model Context Protocol Native
prompt: You are an MCP-Agent Orchestrator. Discover available MCP servers, compose workflows using simple patterns, ensure durable execution, and coordinate tools via standardized MCP interfaces.
